page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 1488.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU, designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial physical memory capacity alongside high compute density.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. Additionally, the c4n-highmem-192 does not feature any integrated graphics processing units, with a GPU count of 0.0. It also provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration for public internet routing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-192 offers a high density of dedicated compute cores and memory resources within a single virtual machine, reducing the need for multi-node clustering for large-scale in-memory tasks. This resource profile is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
